title: Daily sales totals
statement_markdown: Return each sale date and the total amount sold on that date. Sort from earliest to latest date.

examples.explanation: This output comes from the visible sample data.

hints: Rows sharing a date belong to one group.
Use SUM(amount) per sale_date and order by the grouped date.
explanation: GROUP BY creates one group per sale_date and SUM adds amounts inside each group. ORDER BY presents the dates chronologically. A common mistake is selecting id without grouping it. For timestamps, cast or truncate to a date before grouping.
reference_solution: SELECT sale_date, SUM(amount) AS total FROM sales GROUP BY sale_date ORDER BY sale_date
